methods.name: Leather items
methods.note: Needle and thread on bought leather, best item for your level, 215 leather to reach 20. Quests can skip these levels instead.

methods.name: Glassblowing
methods.note: Blow molten glass into the best item for your level, 1,750 an hour, little attention. Ironmen make the glass from sand and soda ash.

methods.name: Gold and gem jewellery
methods.note: Gold bars, with cut gems from 20, at a furnace close to a bank such as Edgeville. Ironmen alch the results for profit.

methods.name: Spinning and weaving yarn
methods.note: Spin flax, hemp or cotton into yarn, then weave bolts of fabric at the Fossil Island wheel and loom. Sometimes a small profit.

methods.name: Cutting gems
methods.note: Chisel on bought uncut gems, 2,780 an hour. Fastest xp up to 77, but dragonstones at 55 cost far more than diamonds.

methods.name: Buying and cutting gems (Mor Ul Rek)
methods.note: Sell chaos runes for Tokkul, buy uncut gems from the TzHaar gem store and cut them. Needs a fire cape and about 3.2M capital.

methods.name: Drift nets
methods.note: Weave two jute fibre a net at the Fossil Island loom, about 1,000 an hour. Beats glassblowing until 46. Ironmen farm the jute.

methods.name: Battlestaves
methods.note: Attach bought orbs to battlestaves, 2,450 an hour. Usually cheaper than the other fast methods but needs a lot of capital.

methods.name: Golem crafting
methods.note: On Wyrmscraig. Mine sunstone, carve golems and clothe them with hunter fur, about 58 an hour. Better fur gives more xp.

methods.name: Superglass Make
methods.note: Cast on 18 buckets of sand and 3 giant seaweed for 180 xp a cast, then blow the glass later for more. Good Magic xp too.

methods.name: Charter ship glassblowing
methods.note: Buy sand and seaweed from charter crew, cast Superglass Make, blow it on the spot, then hop worlds. No banked supplies needed.

methods.name: D'hide bodies
methods.note: Three dragon leathers a body with needle and thread. Fastest viable method from 77. Ironmen use hides from dragons and Vorkath.

methods.name: Cutting amethyst
methods.note: Chisel amethyst into bolt tips, or arrowtips, javelin tips and dart tips at higher levels. A small loss or a profit.

methods.name: Dorgesh-Kaan lamps (own light orbs)
methods.note: Blow light orbs, add wire from the wire machine and fix lamps around the city. Most xp per molten glass, plus 65k to 90k Firemaking.

unverified: Leather items: the guide gives XP per item and a total crafting time (387 seconds for 215 items) but no hourly rate, so xph is 0

Golem crafting: the two guides disagree (main guide 'upwards of 180,000', Ironman Guide 'upwards of 140,000'); 156,600 is from the Golem crafting page (fetched): 58 golems an hour x (1,560 base + 1,140 dark kebbit fur, the fur it recommends for ironmen). Same page: 100,000 low intensity, 185,000+ high intensity, 160,080 with bought moonlight antelope fur, 141,520 with Wyrmscraig goat fur
Golem crafting: Fallen From Grace (fetched) needs 62 Sailing, 60 Crafting, 47 Runecraft, 53 Mining, which confirms the 62 Sailing lead; only the quest is in req
Buying and cutting gems (Mor Ul Rek): level 20 is the sapphire level from the main guide's gem table, the Ironman Guide states no level; the fire cape requirement cannot be expressed in req
Superglass Make: 130,500 is the midpoint of 108,000 to 153,000 for the casts alone (600 to 850 casts an hour), blowing the glass is extra and not included
Dorgesh-Kaan lamps (own light orbs): 110,000 is the midpoint of 90,000 (learning) and 130,000 (skilled); a main can do it from 52 Crafting with bought light orbs but no rate is given for that

Gold and gem jewellery: bands take the best item at each level from the main guide table (1,600 bar-only or 1,400 gem items an hour); the Ironman Guide quotes 35,000 to 42,500 for gold bracelets and 49,000 to 59,500 for gold tiaras
D'hide bodies: needle and thread column (1,685 an hour); the costume needle from Death on the Isle gives 1,705 an hour; the Ironman Guide gives no rate
Drift nets: 60,000 is the main guide rate; the Ironman Guide only gives 1,000 to 2,000 xp of jute per farm run
Glassblowing, Drift nets, Spinning and weaving yarn, Battlestaves, Cutting amethyst: cost is a judgement call because GP/XP columns are live GE price templates
Omitted for lack of a rate: ironman battlestaves (Zaff's daily stock and self-charged orbs), flax spinning, Guardians of the Rift passive xp (5,000 to 6,000/h), shooting star and gem rock gem sources
